import itertools, json, random, sys, time

rng = random.Random(11)

def binary_cell_job(seed, slots, nfields, ntrain, nqueries, tag):
    fields = [{'name': f'f{i}', 'type': 'flag', 'domain': [0, 1]} for i in range(nfields)]
    preds = []
    for slot in range(slots):
        for i in range(nfields):
            for v in (0, 1):
                preds.append({'kind': 'cmp', 'left': {'ref': [slot, f'f{i}']},
                              'op': 'eq', 'right': {'const': v, 'type': 'flag'}})
    preds = preds[:32]
    r = random.Random(seed)
    train = [[[r.choice([0, 1]) for _ in range(nfields)] for _ in range(slots)] for _ in range(ntrain)]
    queries = []
    for i in range(nqueries):
        fixed = [{'ref': [r.randrange(slots), f'f{r.randrange(nfields)}'], 'value': r.choice([0, 1])}]
        queries.append({'target': [r.randrange(slots), f'f{r.randrange(nfields)}'],
                        'prefix': r.choice(['', '0', '1', '01']), 'fixed': fixed})
    return {'fields': fields, 'slots': slots, 'predicates': preds, 'width': 4,
            'train': train, 'approved': [], 'queries': queries}, tag

jobs = []
# two maximal universes (65536 each)
j, _ = binary_cell_job(1, 4, 4, 10000, 128, 'a'); jobs.append(j)
j, _ = binary_cell_job(2, 4, 4, 10000, 128, 'b'); jobs.append(j)
# four smaller ones (16384 each -> total 131072)
for s in range(4):
    j, _ = binary_cell_job(3 + s, 4, 3, 500, 0, 'c'); jobs.append(j)
# wide domain job
big = {'fields': [{'name': 'v', 'type': 'count', 'domain': list(range(65536))}], 'slots': 1,
       'predicates': [{'kind': 'cmp', 'left': {'ref': [0, 'v']}, 'op': 'ge', 'right': {'const': c, 'type': 'count'}} for c in (0, 7, 100, 9000, 60000)],
       'width': 4, 'train': [[rng.randrange(65536)] for _ in range(1000)], 'approved': [],
       'queries': [{'target': [0, 'v'], 'prefix': p, 'fixed': []} for p in ['', '1', '6', '655', '6553', '65535']]}
batch = {'jobs': jobs}
raw = json.dumps(batch)
print('input bytes', len(raw))
open('/workspace/tmp/batch.json', 'w').write(raw)
PYEOF
